CAREERS

Netline Communications Technologies provides force protection & anti-terror solutions to leading defense & HLS agencies. Working at Netline means taking part in life-saving systems development, being involved in new technology and contributing to the safety of Local and worldwide forces.
Working here means working for a successful company with 25 years of experience in the defense industry. Our recruitment process is short, efficient and accurate, keeping in mind that it’s all about people! We at Netline believe in equal opportunities and our employees’ personal and professional growth.
